Overview

Cúcuta is a city in NS with a population of 750,000. A border city near Venezuela, known for its hot climate, commercial activity, and cultural diversity. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
